text:
alex: opening a tiny PR to clarify model fallback ordering in the Dedicated provisioning guide and add one concise tenant-label -> selector example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14099

soph: nice. can you paste the snippet you plan to add for fallback ordering? many customers ask what comes first: pinned version vs quantized variant vs smaller family.

alex: pasted in the PR but copying here for visibility: "Default fallback order: 1) pinned model version, 2) compatible quantized variant, 3) smaller model-family variant. Customers can override via `fallback_order` in the tenant config."

ray: +1. also include a tiny YAML example showing `fallback_order` and a tenant selector mapping. super short so it doesn't bloat the handbook.

alex: adding YAML example now: ```yaml
tenant:
  name: search-team
  labels:
    team: search
    env: prod
  selector: pool=dedicated-us-central,team=search
  fallback_order:
    - pinned_version
    - quantized_8bit
    - smaller-family
```

soph: perfect. two nits: 1) call the SLA field `service_level_target` in the sample, not SLA; 2) add a one-line note that `grace_period_seconds` only applies to `soft` eviction.

alex: updated per nits. also added a minimal Python SDK snippet using the helper so we don't expose internal fields: ```py
from redwood import InferenceClient
client = InferenceClient()
client.create_tenant(name="search-team", labels={"team":"search","env":"prod"}, selector="pool=dedicated-us-central,team=search", fallback_order=["pinned_version","quantized_8bit","smaller-family"])
```

doc-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken link detected: /dedicated/old-fallback -> suggested replacement /dedicated/fallback-order. Automated suggestion applied to branch.

maria: tiny wording nit: replace "smaller-family" with "smaller-model-family" for clarity. also add a single sentence explaining why quantized variants are preferred over smaller families (cost/latency tradeoff).

alex: updated wording and added the one-liner: "Quantized variants are preferred when available because they often offer lower cost with similar latency compared to switching to a smaller model family which can reduce output quality."

indra: approving from docs side. :white_check_mark: Can we also add a short troubleshooting bullet: "If tenant always falls back to smaller family, check that quantized variants are registered and that fallback_order includes them before family."

alex: added troubleshooting bullet and pushed. pinging @soph for final approve so we can merge.

soph: quick read: looks good. doc-bot linkcheck clean. approving. :+1:

doc-bot: CI: linkcheck passed, lint ok, staged deploy successful.

alex: merged. release note: clarified fallback ordering, added YAML + Python helper snippet, replaced 'SLA' with 'service_level_target' in examples, and fixed old fallback link. thanks all! :tada:
